notes: Web-verified metadata; approach summaries for HARCHOC backlog and manuscript response.

entries.title: Explainable ensemble learning method for OCT detection with transfer learning
entries.authors: Yang J, Wang G, Xiao X, Bao M, Tian G
entries.approach_summary: Ensemble of AlexNet, VGG16, and ResNet34 on retinal OCT with ImageNet transfer; majority soft voting; Grad-CAM/CAM for lesion localization. Small clinical OCT set (15 samples per class).
entries.architecture_takeaway: Pretrain + ensemble + XAI for domain shift to a new imaging modality; tray/session finetune should use staged backbone freeze (see tfa2020, gandhi2025_yolov8_freeze), not full retrain from scratch.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer suggests transfer to fresh heads / field lighting. Paper is medical OCT classification, not object detection — valid as **analogy** for source→target adaptation, not a direct architecture swap. Discussion draft: [reviewer gap §12](reviewer_comments_backlog_gap.md#12-manuscript-draft--domain-adaptation-plan-discussion) (**MS-DOMAIN-ADAPT** Done).

entries.title: Harmonizing physical and deep learning modeling: A computationally efficient and interpretable approach for property prediction
entries.authors: Ren D, Wei WC, Zhang Y, Han S, Xu W
entries.approach_summary: Hybrid physics-informed and deep learning framework for material property prediction with emphasis on interpretability and efficiency (tabular/material descriptors, not vision detection).
entries.architecture_takeaway: Motivate **which features drive developed vs aborted** (texture, size, colour) alongside Grad-CAM on seed crops; do not add a separate physics branch without new measurements.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer cites interpretability for breeding trust. Paper is materials science regression — use for **interpretability framing**, pair with **fig_gradcam_panel** and error_taxonomy crops.

entries.title: Unmanned aerial vehicle based multi-person detection via deep neural network models
entries.authors: Alshehri M, Zahoor L, AlQahtani Y, et al.
entries.approach_summary: Deep learning + feature extraction for multi-person **action recognition** in UAV video (MOD20, Okutama-Action); reports ~91.5% / ~89.7% accuracy. Not a literal detect-then-classify cascade paper.
entries.architecture_takeaway: HARCHOC deploy already uses **classifier.pt gate → best2.pt detector** (two-stage). Manuscript should describe this explicitly; HSP eval remains single-stage full-frame export.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer analogy (person detect → identify) is **conceptual**. Our gate rejects non-sunflower images before seed detection — cite as parallel robustness pattern, not identical pipeline.

entries.title: Hierarchical Fuzzy Topological System for High-Dimensional Data Regression Problems
entries.authors: Yao M, Zhao TY, Cao J, Li J
entries.approach_summary: Hierarchical fuzzy system with topology optimization for **high-dimensional regression** (13 real-world tabular datasets); multi-objective evolution balances accuracy vs complexity.
entries.architecture_takeaway: Graded trust on predictions (fuzzy membership on **regression** outputs). Map to detection via locked-conf gate, low-conf band, and FP taxonomy (background/localization dominate; class-agnostic FP volume).
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer §270 (boundary / ambiguous seeds). Yao optimizes fuzzy rules for tabular regression — cite as **analogy** for graded detection trust in Methods + Discussion (gap §15). Implement with existing 2-class YOLO + `error_analysis` ambiguous flags + FP breakdown + `fig_ambiguous_panel`; not a third class or fuzzy YOLO head.

entries.title: GrainNet: efficient detection and counting of wheat grains based on an improved YOLOv7 modeling
entries.approach_summary: YOLOv7 + EMA attention for dense benchtop wheat grains; heavy offline aug (cutout, mixup, mosaic); reports counting MAE/R² vs manual.
entries.architecture_takeaway: Closest kernel-counting peer: report **count MAE + rRMSE** alongside mAP; cite EMA for background-FP narrative only (ARCH-EMA-BG-SPIKE Done — impl. cancelled, see arch_ema_bg_spike_literature.md).
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer theme #2 (originality). Closest kernel-counting peer—contrast single-class counting + EMA/background with harchoc two-class tray MAE + TIDE fp_breakdown. Introduction draft: originality_contribution_peers.md §2–3.

entries.title: LWCD-YOLO: A Lightweight Corn Seed Detection Model Based on YOLOv11
entries.approach_summary: Benchtop corn seeds; offline 10× geometric aug; **Ultralytics mosaic disabled** in training; Grad-CAM for localization errors.
entries.architecture_takeaway: Supports **ARCH-MOSAIC0-AB** (S2 mosaic=0) and Grad-CAM narrative; mosaic-off is evidence-based for dense benchtop seeds.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer theme #2 (originality). Dense benchtop corn seeds; mosaic-off precedent for ARCH-MOSAIC0-AB. Pair with GrainNet in Introduction peer table (originality_contribution_peers.md).

entries.title: Frustratingly Simple Few-Shot Object Detection
entries.authors: Wang X, Huang TE, Darrell T, Gonzalez JE, Saenko K
entries.approach_summary: Two-stage fine-tune: train detector on base classes, freeze backbone+RPN, tune box heads on few-shot set with reduced LR.
entries.architecture_takeaway: Template for **P1-FINETUNE-LOOP** on held-out tray_key: freeze early YOLO layers, fine-tune head on target tray labels.

entries.title: Fine-Tuning Without Forgetting: Adaptation of YOLOv8 Preserves COCO Performance
entries.approach_summary: YOLOv8n freeze-depth sweep; freeze=10 reports large fruit-domain mAP gain with minimal COCO regression.
entries.architecture_takeaway: Operational freeze schedule for `finetune.py` / Ultralytics `freeze` + lower `lr0` on tray holdout.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Not peer-reviewed at check date — label as preprint in manuscript.

entries.title: Global Wheat Head Detection (GWHD) Dataset: A Benchmark Dataset to Estimate the Density and Size of Wheat Heads on Field Conditions
entries.approach_summary: Multi-country wheat head bounding boxes; dense overlap/occlusion; mAP@0.5 matching; defines phenotyping-scale detection benchmarks and duplicate-FP challenges.
entries.architecture_takeaway: Cite for dense-organ phenotyping and counting-error framing (overlap, duplicate FPs); not sunflower-specific.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer theme #6 (literature depth). GWHD is the standard dense-head phenotyping benchmark — positions tray-scale seed counting vs field head detection.

entries.title: Automated Sunflower Head Detection and Yield Estimation from High-Resolution UAV Imagery Using YOLOv11
entries.authors: Iamchuen N, Hongpradit P, Puttinaovarat S, Anucharn T
entries.approach_summary: YOLOv11 on 512×512 UAV tiles for sunflower heads; conf and NMS IoU grids; single-plot study with spatially separated train/val tiles.
entries.architecture_takeaway: Helianthus detection precedent for conf/IoU sweeps; out of benchtop HSP scope — cite in Related Work + limitations, not as direct SOTA comparator.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Sunflower imaging axis for MS-LIT. Head-level UAV counting ≠ developed/aborted tray seeds; supports threshold methodology and generalization caveats.

entries.title: Applications of Transfer Learning in Sunflower Disease Detection: Advances, Challenges, and Future Directions
entries.approach_summary: Systematic review (30 papers) on TL for sunflower disease in field imagery; stresses domain shift and cross-regional validation needs.
entries.architecture_takeaway: Supports Discussion limitations on field/lighting/variety; not seed counting or viability classes.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Sunflower + domain-shift narrative for MS-LIT / MS-GEN; disease classification review, not detection counting peer.
